ledger.x: c. 1200 BCE: the Kuru kingdom forms from the Bharata and Puru tribes. 'The kingdom formed in the Middle Vedic period (c. 1200 to c. 900 BCE) from the alliance and merger of the Bharata and Puru tribes', 'dominant roughly from 1200 to 800 BCE', with Parikshit and Janamejaya as the rulers of its rise. certainty.note: A Vedic kingdom known from texts; the page's bounds are rivers and towns, its dates are 'c.' dates and the infobox contradicts the body.
